exampleSentence: Our team won the relay race at the school sports meeting.
exampleTranslation: 我们队在学校运动会上赢得了接力赛。

exampleSentence: The police released the man after questioning him.
exampleTranslation: 警方在讯问后释放了这名男子。

exampleSentence: The team was relegated to a lower division after a poor season.
exampleTranslation: 球队在经历一个糟糕的赛季后被降到了低一级别。

exampleSentence: Engineers tested the reliability of the system under heavy load.
exampleTranslation: 工程师测试了系统在高负载下的可靠性。

exampleSentence: The country's reliance on imported oil makes it vulnerable.
exampleTranslation: 该国对进口石油的依赖使其容易受到冲击。

exampleSentence: She felt great relief when the test results came back normal.
exampleTranslation: 检查结果正常时，她感到如释重负。

exampleSentence: This medicine can relieve pain for several hours.
exampleTranslation: 这种药可以缓解疼痛几个小时。

exampleSentence: Religion plays an important role in many cultures.
exampleTranslation: 宗教在许多文化中扮演重要角色。

exampleSentence: You can rely on her to keep the secret.
exampleTranslation: 你可以依靠她保守这个秘密。

exampleSentence: The library will remain open until midnight during exams.
exampleTranslation: 考试期间，图书馆将一直开放到午夜。

exampleSentence: She spent the remainder of the afternoon reading.
exampleTranslation: 她把下午剩下的时间用来阅读。

exampleSentence: His remark about the weather started a friendly conversation.
exampleTranslation: 他关于天气的评论开启了一段友好的交谈。

exampleSentence: There is no simple remedy for the shortage of housing.
exampleTranslation: 住房短缺没有简单的解决办法。

exampleSentence: I still remember the first day I moved to this city.
exampleTranslation: 我仍然记得搬到这座城市的第一天。

exampleSentence: Please remind me to call my mother tonight.
exampleTranslation: 请提醒我今晚给妈妈打电话。

exampleSentence: Only a few remnants of the old wall remain.
exampleTranslation: 旧墙只剩下几处残迹。

exampleSentence: The removal of the damaged tree took several hours.
exampleTranslation: 移除受损的树木花了几个小时。

exampleSentence: Please remove your shoes before entering the room.
exampleTranslation: 进入房间前请脱鞋。

exampleSentence: The Renaissance brought new interest in art and science.
exampleTranslation: 文艺复兴重新激发了对艺术和科学的兴趣。

exampleSentence: The heavy rain rendered the road unsafe for driving.
exampleTranslation: 大雨使这条路不适合驾车。

exampleSentence: She went to the office to renew her driver's license.
exampleTranslation: 她去办公室续办驾照。

exampleSentence: The old hotel is closed for renovation until next spring.
exampleTranslation: 这家老酒店因翻新而关闭，直到明年春天。

exampleSentence: The rent for the apartment is due on the first of each month.
exampleTranslation: 这套公寓的租金每月一号到期。

exampleSentence: A mechanic came to repair the broken washing machine.
exampleTranslation: 一名机械师来修理坏掉的洗衣机。

exampleSentence: He promised to repay the loan within two years.
exampleTranslation: 他承诺在两年内偿还贷款。
